6806.title: Execution validation reuses a cached discovery timeout
6806.rootCauseOneLine: Workflow selection uses a picker-mode SDK lookup that returns a cached timeout even after host recovery.
6806.proposedFix: Carry explicit validation intent through the SDK and execution-options route to the existing catalog validation resolver; preserve picker semantics.
6806.caveats: SDK/route/cache recovery reproduced in two clean checkouts with real migrated SQLite and controlled host RPC. Historical macOS load and full workflow dispatch were not executed. No automatic fix because explicit validation intent requires a public API/schema change. Complete test and output are inline in the HTML.
